_comment: Measured extension-vs-corpus divergences, consumed by fixtureWalkers.test.js. opPlan maps fixture name -> verdict override (empty: every applicable fixture in the extension walk runs clean with knownDivergence.extension honoured). providerWire is empty: the client matches the browser reference vector-for-vector (err.status/answered included). oracle maps an oracle/inputs.json case -> the extension's verdict where its profile decides otherwise: a §2 core op at the top level drops with a warning (§8) and an editor-only op is an unknown one, so a case whose failure lives inside such an op is valid here; the JSON caps (E_JSON_LIMIT) hold on every surface.
